LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 1.3.1 SUBJECT-VERB AGREEMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Language Use 1.3.1 Subject-verb agreement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 1.3.1 Subject-verb agreement, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we write correct sentences? 7 - Does she walk home every day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 1.3.1 Subject-verb agreement together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to write clearly and correctly is developed as they write words with descenders and target

letter-sound combinations bl, br, ch, and cl.

• Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is enhanced as they practise writing clearly and legibly on their own.

Values:
Respect: A learner waits patiently to take turns in constructing sentences using subject-verb agreement.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self- awareness): A learner’s self-awareness is developed as they construct sentences using objects at home and at school.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies knowledge of subject-verb agreement to learning of similar concept in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Print textbooks in appropriate font size and colour contrast

● Braille books

● digital devices with assistive technology,

● charts, flash cards or braille cards,

● pictures or picture description
